question_or_proposition: From what date are the Whole Effluent Toxicity monitoring and reporting requirements governed by footnote *9 first applicable, and what additional Part II WET conditions (including any frequency reduction option) modify whether and how often that monitoring was required during Federal FY2025?
required_context: Part II Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements referenced in footnote *9
notes: Footnote *9 ties commencement of monitoring and reporting to the permit effective date and defers further WET conditions to Part II. Resolving when WET monitoring first became required and whether Part II alters frequency affects monitoring-obligation applicability (Purpose B) and how to classify missing WET results within FY2025 (Purpose C). The adjacent Part I table lists WET parameters as report-only, so Purpose A is unlikely to turn on this passage alone.
